messages:
Caroline: FYI PR 47802 fixes a race around model cache eviction that caused OOMs on heavy concurrent warmups. Small diff, but this needs runtime + infra + security eyes for a hotfix cut in the 13:00 PT window. https://repo.redwood.dev/r/47802 :eyes:
Mike: I can take runtime. Will run the new allocator test locally and sanity-check kv cache behavior, 20m.
Ash: Security here — quick question: did this change touch any dependency versions or add new unsafe FFI? If not I can give a fast +1 after unit/e2e pass.
Deepa: Infra pinged — I can look for eviction side effects and CI perf run. Any perf artifacts I should check?
Caroline: No deps, no new FFI. Tests: unit + e2e green on the branch. Perf artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/abcd1234 (look at mem/alloc and p99 tail).
Mike: quick snippet I ran locally: ```diff
- if (cache_size > threshold) evict();
+ if (cache_size > threshold && !is_prefetching()) evict();
```Looks straightforward. I want to run one canary of the warmup flow to validate KV reuse.
Ash: Thanks — adding a short security justification block to the PR would help ops/audit: please include why the prefetched entries are safe to skip during prefetch. Small suggestion.
Caroline: done, pushed a follow-up commit with the comment and a one-line note in the PR body per Ash's request.
Deepa: Running perf canary now against staging-alloc. If mem / p99 look good I'll +1. ETA ~10m.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 13:12 PT for pr/47802 -> staging (owner: Jordan).
Jordan: I can merge once runtime + infra + security approvals are present. I’ll hold the merge until Deepa and Ash confirm.
Deepa: Perf looks fine — mem delta is +1.2% under load, p99 unaffected, no regressions in eviction counts. +1 from infra.
Ash: Security quick pass complete — no dependency or FFI issues, reasoning in PR looks good. +1.
Mike: Runtime +1. KV reuse validated in a short warmup run.
Jordan: All approvals present, I’ll merge at 13:05 PT and schedule the hotfix rollout with the usual canary ramp. Thanks everyone :tada:
Caroline: Thank you all — leaving the follow-up monitoring checklist in the PR and runbook. If anything odd shows up, ping #eng-oncall. :heart:
